findings.label: Flow webhook handler missing
findings.description: The flow publish transform (TransformCMSFlow) is shown but the webhook handler that receives CMS flow publish events, calls the transform, and stores the flow with its group_id is not shown. Add HandleCMSFlowPublish or clarify if existing handler just needs modification.

findings.label: Connection-only update version increment path unclear
findings.description: The replaceGroupConnections function correctly increments groups.version, but HandlePutGroup doesn't show connection update logic. Clarify whether HandlePutGroup handles connections array and calls replaceGroupConnections.

findings.label: Canary manifest generation not specified
findings.description: Canary deployment requires separate worker-{group}-canary deployment/service but generate-manifests CLI doesn't show how to generate them. Add --canary flag or clarify if canary manifests are created ad-hoc.

findings.label: Default group K8s manifest timing unspecified
findings.description: The chicken-egg problem is explained but who/when generates default group's K8s manifests during initial cluster setup is not specified. Add explicit bootstrap runbook instructions.

findings.label: Full group deletion RTO is optimistic
findings.description: Stated 5-15 min RTO assumes fast GitOps sync. With PR review required, realistic RTO is 30+ minutes. Update RTO to reflect normal path vs emergency path separately.

findings.label: Auto-rollback health check signal source undefined
findings.description: DeploymentWatcher checks worker.Ready but what makes Ready=false isn't defined. Is it K8s readiness probe? Prometheus metric? Clarify the health signal source.

findings.label: KEDA metric source clarification needed
findings.description: KEDA trigger uses gateway_dispatch_total metric. Clarify that this metric is emitted by the gateway (always running) so KEDA can scale from 0.

findings.label: Scaling.Mode validation gap
findings.description: ValidateGroup doesn't validate that mode is one of the three valid values (static|dynamic|ephemeral). SQL CHECK constraint catches it but API should fail earlier. Add mode validation.

findings.label: Flow reassignment audit capture code missing
findings.description: flow_group_audit table schema is shown but no code captures changes to flow_versions.group_id. Add FlowStore audit capture code or reference where it will live.

findings.label: Circuit breaker state not persisted
findings.description: Circuit breaker for cross-group calls is in-memory. Gateway restart resets all breakers to closed, potentially causing thundering herd to broken group. Document if this is acceptable or consider shared state.

findings.label: Delete group flow count check race condition
findings.description: Delete checks COUNT(*) then deletes. Concurrent flow assignment between check and delete causes generic FK violation error, not friendly message. Consider SELECT FOR UPDATE or document the race.

findings.label: CMS Group flows relation bypass not enforced
findings.description: Comment says flows relation is intentionally omitted from group content type, but nothing prevents CMS operator from adding it manually. Consider webhook validation that ignores/warns if populated.
